body: Could we return `true` for both `selectPrivacyMode` and `selectPerpsCrossMarginEnabledFlag` here? The current mock disables the Cross branch, so this test does not exercise privacy masking for the new “No liquidation price” value. Please enable both selectors and assert that the dots render and the unmasked Cross liquidation text is absent.
action: Enabled both selectors, asserted Cross badge, masked dots, and absence of unmasked liquidation text.

body: Please pass the raw feature-flag value directly to `validatedVersionGatedFeatureFlag`. Its parameter is `unknown` and it performs runtime narrowing, so `as unknown as VersionGatedFeatureFlag` discards type safety without enabling valid access.
action: Removed the double cast; raw value passed to the unknown-typed validator.

body: These four keys are duplicated later in `orderValidation`, and the JSON parser retains the later definitions. Consequently, none of this new copy reaches users. Could we update the existing definitions at lines 2336–2339 and remove these duplicates?
action: Removed the duplicated keys and moved the new copy into the existing definitions.

body: The account summary already labels account-wide collateral as “Margin used.” This change gives the individual position value the same label on the same screen, leaving traders unable to identify which scope each value represents. Could we distinguish them as “Account margin used” and “Position margin used,” or use “Margin” with the Cross tag for the position?
action: Renamed the Cross position label to "Position margin used" (Lite and Pro), leaving the account summary unchanged.
